info.description: OllyGarden's REST API for observability insights, service metadata, webhooks, and Rose code analysis workflows.
info.title: OllyGarden REST API

get.description: Returns log volume broken down by severity for your whole organization over a time range. Use it to spot noisy severities and trends.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

get.description: Returns active API key metadata for the authenticated organization, newest first. Secret material is never returned.

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-100)
parameters.name: limit

401.description: Unauthorized

post.description: Creates an API key for the authenticated organization. The plaintext key is returned exactly once.

401.description: Unauthorized

delete.description: Deactivates an active key owned by the authenticated organization, retaining audit data. Self-revocation is allowed. Returns 404 API_KEY_NOT_FOUND for inactive, missing, or other-organization keys. The receiving Olive replica invalidates its cache before responding; other Olive replicas and Raincatcher may accept cached keys for up to five minutes. Requests already authenticated may finish.

401.description: Unauthorized

get.description: Returns a paginated list of telemetry quality insights across your organization, with filters for status, exact insight type name, signal type, impact, service, and date range. Set snapshot=true for a mutation-stable scan with a signed cursor bound to this credential, endpoint, filters, and sort for at most 15 minutes. On HTTP 410, restart with snapshot=true, no cursor, and no non-zero offset; snapshot capacity is bounded and may return HTTP 503.

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-100, default: 20)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Start mutation-stable snapshot pagination; cannot be combined with a non-zero offset
parameters.name: snapshot

parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous snapshot page
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Filter by 1-100 exact insight type names (comma-separated, each 1-128 characters)
parameters.name: insight_type

parameters.description: Filter by signal type (trace, metric, log)
parameters.name: signal_type

parameters.description: Sort field with +/- prefix (default: -created_at). Valid: created_at, detected_ts, updated_at, impact, signal_type
parameters.name: sort

401.description: Unauthorized

delete.description: Closes an unfinished mutation-stable insights snapshot before it expires. Send the same filters and sort used to create the cursor; the call is idempotent and intended for bounded scans that deliberately stop early.

parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the unfinished insights snapshot
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Original comma-separated exact insight type name filter (1-100 values, each 1-128 characters)
parameters.name: insight_type

401.description: Unauthorized

get.description: Returns one insight with its full attributes, related service, and insight type including remediation instructions.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

get.description: Returns an AI-generated plain-language summary of one insight. The summary is cached after first generation, so repeat calls are fast.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

401.description: Unauthorized

200.description: Already running, cooldown, already instrumented, or not implemented

401.description: Unauthorized

post.description: Starts a Rose review run that analyzes a repository's instrumentation and reports findings. Accepts a Clerk user session or an API key; poll the returned execution for progress.

post.description: Requires a Clerk user session. Cancels an organization-owned codebase run and attempts sandbox cleanup. Returns execution detail; repeated cancellation is idempotent. Already-completed or failed runs return 409. Finalization already in progress settles first; remote branches and pull requests are not rolled back.

401.description: Unauthorized

get.description: Returns a paginated list of code findings across your organization, with optional severity and category filters.

401.description: Unauthorized

get.description: Returns counts of active findings for your organization, faceted by severity and category. Use it for dashboard totals.

401.description: Unauthorized

get.description: Returns the repositories connected to Rose, nested under their GitHub App installations, with VCS identifiers and canonical URLs.

401.description: Unauthorized

parameters.description: Service name to find repositories for
parameters.name: serviceName

401.description: Unauthorized

get.description: Returns one connected repository with its activation state, instrumentation metadata, and active findings.

401.description: Unauthorized

patch.description: Turns Rose analysis on or off for a repository. Activation is subject to your organization's repository limit.

401.description: Unauthorized

patch.description: Dismisses a finding with an optional reason, or restores a previously dismissed one. Send {"dismissed":true,"dismissed_reason":"..."} to dismiss and {"dismissed":false} to restore; restoring clears the stored reason and timestamp.

401.description: Unauthorized

post.description: Binds a service identity to an active repository, moving it from any other repository in your organization. Returns 201 when the binding is created or moved and 200 when it already exists. Requires a Clerk user session; API keys receive 403.

401.description: Unauthorized

get.description: Returns a paginated list of monitored services with their instrumentation scores. Filter with favorite=true to see only the services you have starred.

get.description: Returns services grouped by name, namespace, and environment, with version counts and active insight totals. Set view=service with snapshot=true for one mutation-stable row per name/namespace identity, combined environments, active insight counts, last_seen, and an exact total. Snapshot cursors are bound to the credential, endpoint, filters, and sort for at most 15 minutes; on HTTP 410, restart with snapshot=true, no cursor, and no non-zero offset. Machine-generated per-instance identities (names matching crio-conmon-* or systemd-coredump@*) are excluded from both views.

parameters.description: Search query to filter services by name
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Service-identity view: restrict facts to one environment
parameters.name: environment

parameters.description: Service-identity view: require an active insight of this type
parameters.name: has_insight_type

parameters.description: Maximum number of groups to return (1-100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of groups to skip for pagination
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Start mutation-stable snapshot pagination; cannot be combined with a non-zero offset
parameters.name: snapshot

parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous snapshot page
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Legacy sort, or score/name/insight_count/last_seen with view=service
parameters.name: sort

200.description: Successfully retrieved legacy groups or service summaries when view=service

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

410.description: Snapshot cursor is invalid or expired; restart with snapshot=true, no cursor, and no non-zero offset

delete.description: Closes an unfinished mutation-stable snapshot from /services/grouped?view=service before it expires. Send the same filters and sort used to create the cursor; the call is idempotent.

401.description: Unauthorized

get.description: Returns the most recent AI-interpreted telemetry-quality findings for the authenticated organization as a raw artifact without an envelope. Accepts an Olive API key, Clerk session, or configured Clerk OAuth access token. The optional legacy orgId parameter is only used to validate that it matches the authenticated organization. Findings are produced in two phases, so groups may carry analysis null until the narrative phase completes; a 404 means no findings run has completed yet.

parameters.description: Legacy organization identifier; when supplied, it must match the authenticated organization
parameters.name: orgId

401.description: Unauthorized — bearer token missing or invalid

403.description: orgId does not match the authenticated organization

404.description: No findings available for this org yet

502.description: Failed to read findings from bucket

503.description: Magnolia query engine is not configured

get.description: Returns the most recent pre-computed Magnolia telemetry analysis report for the authenticated organization as a single full payload. Accepts an Olive API key, Clerk session, or configured Clerk OAuth access token. The optional legacy orgId parameter is only used to validate that it matches the authenticated organization. Reports are refreshed once per sampling run and can be cached for up to one hour.

parameters.description: Legacy organization identifier; when supplied, it must match the authenticated organization
parameters.name: orgId

401.description: Unauthorized — bearer token missing or invalid

403.description: orgId does not match the authenticated organization

404.description: No report available for this org yet

502.description: Failed to read report from bucket

503.description: Magnolia query engine is not configured

datapoints.description:
Datapoints and the per-type breakdown are present when the row came
from service-metrics.

log_count.description: LogCount is present when the row came from service-logs.

span_count.description: SpanCount and TraceCount are present when the row came from service-traces.

insights_count.description: Number of active insights for the most recent version

instrumentation_score.description: Latest instrumentation quality score for the most recent version. Omitted if no score exists.

is_favorite.description: Whether any version in this service group is marked as a favorite by the current user

latest_id.description: ID of the newest service version (greatest first_seen_at)

name.description: Service name from OpenTelemetry service.name attribute

version_count.description: Number of different versions for this service group

attributes.description: Dynamic object containing insight-specific attributes and telemetry data

detected_ts.description: When the insight was detected by the system

service_environment.description: Service environment (populated when insights are fetched with service info)

service_id.description: ID of the service this insight belongs to

service_name.description: Service name (populated when insights are fetched with service info)

service_namespace.description: Service namespace (populated when insights are fetched with service info)

service_version.description: Service version (populated when insights are fetched with service info)

status.description: Current status of the insight (active, archived, muted)

telemetry_ts.description: Timestamp from the telemetry data that triggered this insight (can be null)

updated_at.description: When the insight was last updated

cached.description: Cached indicates if this summary was retrieved from cache

content.description: Content is the generated summary text

generated_at.description: GeneratedAt is when the summary was generated

insight_id.description: InsightID is the unique identifier of the insight

model.description: Model is the LLM model used to generate the summary

created_at.description: When the insight type was created

description.description: Detailed description of what this insight detects

display_name.description: Human-readable name for the insight type

impact.description: Impact level of the detected issue

instrumentation_score_rule_id.description: Associated instrumentation score rule ID (if any)

name.description: Internal name/slug for the insight type

remediation_instructions.description: Detailed instructions on how to fix the detected issue

signal_type.description: Type of telemetry signal this insight applies to

updated_at.description: When the insight type was last updated

calculated_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the score was calculated

calculation_window_seconds.description: Time window in seconds used for score calculation

created_at.description: When the score record was created

evaluated_rule_ids.description: List of instrumentation rule IDs that were evaluated

total_count.description: Total log record count across all severities

record_count.description: Number of log records for this severity

severity_text.description: Severity level (TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL, UNKNOWN)

created_at.description: When the service record was created

first_seen_at.description: When the service was first detected

instrumentation_score.description: Latest instrumentation quality score for this service. Omitted if no instrumentation score has been calculated for the service yet.

is_favorite.description: Whether this service is marked as a favorite by the current user (computed from user_service_favorites)

last_seen_at.description: When the service was last seen sending telemetry

name.description: Service name from OpenTelemetry service.name attribute

namespace.description: Service namespace from OpenTelemetry service.namespace attribute (can be empty)

updated_at.description: When the service record was last updated

name.description: Never empty: nameless services are excluded from the identity view (E-4070).

environments.description: Environments to subscribe to; empty means all

min_severity.description: Minimum severity level (Low, Normal, Important, Critical)

organization_id.description: Organization that owns this webhook configuration

url.description: HTTPS URL to deliver events to
